question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Pronounciation'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is 'Pronounciation'. The correct spelling for the given word is **'Pronunciation'.**
 
• **Pronunciation**__**: The way in which a particular letter word or sound is said. (किसी शब्‍द या ध्वनि का उच्‍चारण)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- His grammar is good but his **pronunciation** is awful!
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **'option 4'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Interpretation**__**: ****An explanation or understanding of something (समझ)**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- What’s your **interpretation** of these statistics?
 
 
 
• ​__**Tremendous**__**: Very good (बहुत अच्‍छा)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- It was a **tremendous** experience.
 
 
 
• ​__**Persistent**__**: Lasting for a long time or happening often (लंबे समय तक रहने वाला या बार-बार होने वाला)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- I had a **persistent** cough.
